purpose: P3.5 final sweep — enumerate every sahool-platform file (all non-test packages: api/, core/, workers/ and the root scripts — W1-22 widened the scan from api/ only) that still performs direct Open-Meteo wiring (imports api.connectors.openmeteo or calls fetch_current/fetch_daily_forecast/fetch_historical/fetch_weather_tile_data) and pin each to an honest reason. The guard test scans api/**/*.py and fails on any offender that is neither a legitimate home nor a documented residual.
marker_detection: Structural (ast), not textual. A file is an offender when it IMPORTS the connector module in any spelling (import api.connectors.openmeteo / from api.connectors.openmeteo import … / from api.connectors import openmeteo) or NAMES one of its provider-touching fetchers in code. Prose and comments never make a file an offender — the textual scan used to keep a file listed for the comment that explained why it had stopped importing the connector. The alternate `from api.connectors import openmeteo` spelling matched none of the old string markers (measured: zero matches), and fetch_bundle/fetch_current_batch were absent from the list although both reach the provider.

legitimate_homes.api/connectors/openmeteo.py: The Open-Meteo provider adapter itself. The single sanctioned place that speaks to the Open-Meteo HTTP provider (with the circuit breaker). All other platform weather reads should flow through weather-service (via api/weather_service_client.py) or this adapter, not re-open provider transport.
legitimate_homes.api/weather_service_client.py: The P3.4 weather-service boundary transport (weather-service system-of-record). Thin HTTP client the platform uses to reach weather-service; it does NOT import Open-Meteo connectors (so it does not match the markers above) but is listed here as the sanctioned weather transport home.

composite_residuals_pending_p4.api/routers/weather.py: ONLY weather_wind_source_selftest (GET /api/v1/weather/wind-source-selftest, service-token): an operator live diagnostic of the provider adapter itself and its MET.no fallback, not a data path. Enforced at function level by test_the_only_residual_is_the_provider_self_test. It is the adapter's last executable root: without it api/connectors/openmeteo.py and core/circuit_breaker.py become unreachable and platform_module_reachability_guard --check blocks; INHERITED_UNREACHABLE only shrinks without an owner decision. Removing it therefore needs the owner to decide to delete the platform adapter (and migrate its unit tests to weather-service's open_meteo.py) — W1-22 left that decision open.

composite_residuals_ceiling_note: A ratchet, enforced by test_the_documented_residuals_only_ever_shrink: the number of documented residuals may only go DOWN. The list previously carried 10 entries, every one of them marked 'pending P4' since the original sweep, with nothing in the tree that would turn red if they stayed forever — an exemption with no descending ceiling is not deferred debt, it is a silent write-off. Lowered 10 -> 9 when api/routers/field_workspace_weather.py moved behind api/weather_service_client.py (irrigation-advice + disease-risk now read the weather-service views instead of the provider adapter). Lowered 9 -> 8 when api/routers/seasons.py moved behind api/weather_service_client.get_weather_historical (season simulation reads the canonical weather-service historical view, validated by api/season_simulation.canonical_historical_days). Raising this number requires editing it here, in the open. Lowered 8 -> 1 by W1-22: every data-path residual (recommendations, alerts, ETc, tiles/field-summary/alerts/probe, the AI context pack, the field dashboard, the season workspace and the weather automation worker) now reads weather-service through api/weather_service_client.py; the one entry left is the provider self-test, held at function level, pending the owner's decision to delete the platform adapter.

closed_residuals.api/routers/field_workspace_weather.py: Closed: irrigation-advice + disease-risk now call weather_service_client.get_current_weather / get_weather_forecast. The two routes had function-local `from api.connectors.openmeteo import fetch_current, fetch_daily_forecast` imports while the rest of the same file already used the weather-service client at module level. The circuit breaker was NOT bypassed (open_meteo._fetch_json guards it on every provider call); what was bypassed is the P3.4 facade contract and weather-service's shared cache. Conversion needed an adapter because the connector returns typed objects (CurrentWeather / list[DailyForecast]) while the client returns the CanonicalWeatherState views as dicts — same field names, but the forecast days sit under a `days` envelope key, and a missing reading arrives as None named in `missing_fields` (quality_status: degraded) instead of the connector's silent `.get(key, 0)` default. Two pre-existing defects closed with the move: an absent reading became 0 (0 degC + 0% humidity reads as LOW disease risk — a reassuring answer built from no data), and a null reading became float(None) -> TypeError -> 500. Both are now an explicit 503 naming the missing input. Witnessed by tests_v9/test_weather_views_survive_the_hop_to_the_platform.py, which runs the real weather-service producer into the real platform adapter rather than faking either end.
closed_residuals.api/routers/seasons.py: Closed: POST /api/v1/seasons/{season_id}/simulate no longer imports api.connectors.openmeteo.fetch_historical. It calls weather_service_client.get_weather_historical with the tenant id, and api/season_simulation.canonical_historical_days refuses a product that is not a canonical weather-service view, lacks coverage proof for the exact window, or has a missing, shifted or duplicated day — before any season_simulation_runs row is written. Witnessed by services/sahool-platform/tests/test_season_weather_contract.py and test_season_spatial_provenance.py::test_missing_archive_day_rejected_before_any_simulation_write.
closed_residuals.api/routers/weather.py: Closed by W1-22: the tile sampler behind tile-data/field-summary/alerts (_get_weather_sample_cached), and the point probe call weather_service_client.get_point_weather_sample (weather-service /v1/weather/tile-data at zoom 18; a neutral or sample-less tile raises instead of becoming an empty sample). readyz/health no longer report the platform's own Open-Meteo breaker, which no request passes through any more: they declare breaker {state: delegated, owner: weather-service}. The file stays listed as a residual for the provider self-test only (see composite_residuals_pending_p4).
closed_residuals.api/main.py: Closed by W1-22: _evaluate_field_alerts_persist (field alerts + the all-fields alert run) reads forecast and current weather through api/weather_service_client typed readings (weather-service views; absent readings stay None).
closed_residuals.api/field_context.py: Closed by W1-22: _historical_rain_3d_mm (recommendations, alerts, season workspace) reads the canonical weather-service historical view through api/weather_service_client.historical_readings; the fixed expected_count=3 completeness rule is unchanged.
closed_residuals.api/routers/fields.py: Closed by W1-22: GET /api/v1/fields/{id}/recommendations and the two legacy helpers (irrigation advice, disease risk) read forecast/current through api/weather_service_client typed readings.
closed_residuals.api/routers/etc_dual.py: Closed by W1-22: POST /api/v1/fields/{id}/etc-dual reads the day's forecast and current reading through api/weather_service_client typed readings; a weather-service failure or a view without days is a 503, weather_source is 'weather-service'.
closed_residuals.api/routers/field_ai_context.py: Closed by W1-22: the AI context pack reads the canonical historical view with the tenant identity (weather_service_client.get_weather_historical). weather-4: totals were summed as float(x or 0), so a day without a rain/ET0 reading counted as a dry day; summarize_weather_history now returns None for an incomplete total (pack-wide and per month) and names the missing-day count, and carries the owner's coverage/quality/limitations. Witnessed by services/sahool-platform/tests/test_weather_client_routing_w1_22.py.
closed_residuals.api/routers/season_workspace.py: Closed by W1-22: the season workspace recommendations read forecast/current through api/weather_service_client typed readings.
closed_residuals.api/weather_automation.py: Closed by W1-22: refresh_all reads current weather through api/weather_service_client.current_reading; the WMO description moved to api/weather_service_client.py (re-exported by the connector).

neutral_tile_guarantee: api/weather_service_client.py get_weather_tile_data/get_operation_tile_data catch a 502 (weather-service unreachable) and return a neutral tile (value=null, available=false, cache_state=service_unavailable) instead of propagating one Bad Gateway per tile. This preserves the pre-extraction 'don't flood the map with 502 per tile' guarantee across the platform->weather-service network hop.
final_sweep_status: P3.5 complete; W1-22: platform weather data paths read weather-service only (api/weather_service_client.py, including its typed readings current_reading / forecast_readings / historical_readings). Direct Open-Meteo wiring exists only in api/connectors/openmeteo.py and, by owner-pending exception, in the provider self-test weather_wind_source_selftest (held at function level, ceiling 1). New offenders anywhere in the platform's non-test code are blocked by tests/test_p3_5_weather_direct_wiring_final_sweep.py.
